description: Build video player with AVPlayer (iOS + tvOS variants). Implement custom SwiftUI player controls overlay, subtitle selection menu, audio track picker, quality selector, playback speed controls, skip intro/credits buttons. tvOS version: Siri Remote support with swipe gestures. iOS version: touch gestures (double-tap seek, pinch zoom, swipe brightness/volume). Create AVPlayer wrapper with state management.
title: Phase 3.6: iOS/tvOS Video Player with AVPlayer
